headline: REDEMPLO momentum builds while R&D spend widens losses
summary_short: Arrowhead's fiscal Q3 revenue rose 2.1% q/q and 171.0% y/y to $75.3M on continued REDEMPLO launch momentum and collaboration payments, while net loss attributable to the company widened 46.4% q/q and 10.9% y/y to $194.3M (-$1.36 diluted EPS) as R&D and SG&A spend both increased.
summary_long: Revenue rose 2.1% q/q and 171.0% y/y to $75.3M as REDEMPLO's US launch kept building (prescription volume roughly doubled; 400+ unique prescribers) alongside new EC and Australian TGA marketing authorizations, plus continued collaboration revenue from partners. R&D rose to $198.2M (from $162.4M y/y) and SG&A to $47.1M (from $30.9M y/y), pushing the operating loss to $170.1M, up 20.4% q/q. Net loss attributable to Arrowhead widened 46.4% q/q and 10.9% y/y to $194.3M ($1.36 diluted loss/share), amplified by a swing to a $15.4M noncontrolling-interest allocation versus a $3.4M loss allocation a year earlier. Stockholders' equity fell 24.2% q/q to $465.5M on the net loss and a new $682.7M convertible-notes balance. The release gives no forward revenue, EPS, or expense guidance.

drivers.explanation: REDEMPLO's US launch kept building momentum — prescription volume roughly doubled in the quarter with over 400 unique prescribers — plus new EC and Australian TGA marketing authorizations expanding the addressable patient base, alongside continued collaboration payments from partners.
Not explained in the release beyond the underlying expense totals: R&D rose to $198.2M (from $162.4M y/y) and SG&A to $47.1M (from $30.9M y/y), outpacing revenue growth.
Total other expense fell to $8.8M from $13.5M y/y, nearly offsetting the wider operating loss and leaving the pretax loss roughly flat y/y; not explained in the release.

Not explained for the operating components; arithmetically, a $15.4M net-income allocation to noncontrolling interest this quarter (versus a $3.4M loss allocation a year earlier) is what pulls the loss attributable to Arrowhead below the pretax loss.
Follows mechanically from the wider net loss attributable to Arrowhead against a diluted share count that grew only modestly (143.4M vs 142.4M q/q, 139.0M y/y).

Not explicitly addressed in the release; the quarter's roughly $194M net loss mechanically reduces equity, and a new $682.7M convertible-notes balance (versus none a year earlier) adds leverage rather than offsetting it.

CEO framed the quarter around 'transformational events': positive Phase 3 SHASTA-3/4 results for plozasiran, an FDA priority review voucher acquisition, continued REDEMPLO US commercial momentum plus two new international authorizations, and broad RNAi pipeline progress.
